answer.says: The particular has its right to exist, and I am merely exercising it; but I will not let the universal form of commerce be blocked by my particular vanity.
answer.thought: The bookseller’s impatience is the friction of civil society: the particular individual obstructing the flow of needs. I have forty-six rupees; I will spend them on the newspaper, which is the universal medium that connects the particular to the whole, and then I shall withdraw, leaving the shop to its function.
